content: त्रेता .²1 A triad, triplet. .²2 The three sacred fires taken collectively (गार्हपत्य, दक्षिण and आहवनीय); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 2. 231</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 9. 14. 44</ls>; त्रेताग्निधूमाग्रमनिन्द्यकीर्तेस्तस्येदमाक्रान्तविमानमार्गम् <ls>R. 13. 37</ls>. .²3 A particular throw at dice, a cast of three or trey; त्रेताहृतसर्वस्वः <ls>Mk. 2. 8</ls>. .²4 The second of the four Yugas of the Hindus; see युग.
